#| label: load-packages
#| include: false
if (!requireNamespace("vpro", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("The vpro package must be installed to render this report.")
}
if (!requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("The knitr package must be installed to render this report.")
}

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| include: false
required <- c("project_path", "project", "su_path", "su")
for (key in required) {
  value <- params[[key]]
  if (!is.character(value) || length(value) != 1L || is.na(value) || !nzchar(trimws(value))) {
    stop("Supply an explicit ", key, ".")
  }
}
reference_path <- params$reference_path
if (!is.character(reference_path) || length(reference_path) != 1L || is.na(reference_path)) {
  stop("reference_path must be a single character string (empty for bundled VLists.db).")
}
report <- local({
  context <- vpro::vpro_project_context()
  on.exit(vpro::vpro_project_close(context), add = TRUE)
  vpro::vpro_project_attach(context, params$project_path, params$project)
  vpro::vpro_project_activate(context, params$project)
  vpro::vpro_su_attach(context, params$su_path, params$su)
  vpro::vpro_su_activate(context, params$su)
  if (nzchar(reference_path)) {
    vpro::vpro_report_long_environment(context, reference_path = reference_path)
  } else {
    vpro::vpro_report_long_environment(context)
  }
})

escape_html <- function(value) {
  value <- as.character(value)
  value <- gsub("&", "&amp;", value, fixed = TRUE)
  value <- gsub("<", "&lt;", value, fixed = TRUE)
  value <- gsub(">", "&gt;", value, fixed = TRUE)
  value <- gsub('"', "&quot;", value, fixed = TRUE)
  value
}

status_label <- function(status) {
  switch(status,
    ok = "OK", missing_env = "Missing Env", missing_admin = "Missing Admin",
    missing_unit_name = "Missing unit name", conflicting_unit_names = "Conflicting unit names",
    status
  )
}
```

Project: `r params$project`. Site-unit table: `r params$su`.

```{r}
#| label: render-units
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (nrow(report$units) == 0L) {
  cat("No eligible site-unit memberships.\n")
} else {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(report$units))) {
    unit <- report$units[i, , drop = FALSE]
    unit_code <- unit$SiteUnit[[1L]]
    heading <- if (nzchar(unit_code)) unit_code else "(blank site-unit code)"
    cat("\n## Site unit: ", escape_html(heading), "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("**Unit title:** ", escape_html(unit$title[[1L]]), "\n\n", sep = "")
    if (unit$name_status[[1L]] != "ok") {
      cat("**Unit-name status:** ", status_label(unit$name_status[[1L]]), "\n\n", sep = "")
    }
    candidates <- report$names$candidate_names[[i]]
    if (unit$name_status[[1L]] == "conflicting_unit_names") {
      cat("**Conflicting candidate names:** ",
        paste(escape_html(candidates), collapse = "; "), "\n\n", sep = "")
    }

    plots <- report$plots[report$plots$SiteUnit == unit_code, , drop = FALSE]
    labels <- plots$PlotNumber
    labels[!nzchar(labels)] <- "(blank plot number)"
    if (anyDuplicated(labels)) stop("Plot headers are not unique within site unit: ", unit_code)
    values <- list(
      `Membership plot number` = plots$PlotNumber,
      `Plot status` = vapply(plots$status, status_label, character(1)),
      `Membership rows` = plots$duplicate_membership_count
    )
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(report$fields))) {
      field <- report$fields[j, , drop = FALSE]
      if (field$heading[[1L]]) {
        values[[field$label[[1L]]]] <- rep("", nrow(plots))
      } else {
        values[[field$label[[1L]]]] <- plots[[field$label[[1L]]]]
      }
    }
    table <- data.frame(Field = names(values), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
    for (j in seq_along(labels)) {
      table[[labels[[j]]]] <- vapply(values, function(column) {
        value <- column[[j]]
        if (is.na(value)) "" else as.character(value)
      }, character(1))
    }
    cat('<div class="table-responsive" role="region" aria-label="Environmental fields by plot" tabindex="0">\n')
    cat(knitr::kable(table, format = "html", row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE), "\n")
    cat("</div>\n\n")
  }
}
```
